narrative.overview: A deep blue navigation shell frames cool, pale support surfaces. White conversation and reading areas stay visually central; lime highlights the selected destination and lends emphasis to approval states. The result is distinctive but familiar to operate.
keyCharacteristics: Deep blue navigation and primary controls
Pale blue-green supporting regions and white reading surfaces
Lime selection and clearly labelled approval states
Humanist typography and concise, scannable groupings
dos: Do keep the selected customer, preview status, and conversation easy to identify.
Do use explicit labels alongside state colors.
Do preserve readable conversation content and responsive navigation.
Do distinguish local approvals from executed reset requests.
donts: Don't let supporting regions obscure the conversation.
Don't present a simulated link as operational or a local approval as an executed action.
